title: A quantitative RT-PCR protocol to adapt and quantify RBM20-dependent exon splicing of targets at the human locus
protocol: Dissolve the cell pellet in 500 μL lysis buffer by pipetting.
Add 500 μL dilution buffer and vortex for 10 s.
Centrifuge 3 min at 10,000 g.
Transfer supernatant to a new 1.5 mL tube and add 340 μL isopropanol.
Mix by vortexing for 10 s and transfer the solution onto the QiaAmp column.
Wash the column twice with 500 μL washing buffer (centrifuge 1 min at 16,000 g and discard flow-through).
Place column into a new 1.5 mL tube and add 40-50 μL water directly onto the membrane and incubate 5 min at room temperature.
Centrifuge 1 min at 16,000 g and discard the column.
Determine RNA concentration with a Nanodrop.
Dilute the RNA with water if the concentration is higher than 200 ng/μL.
Dilute 100 ng RNA in 13 μL water.
Add 2 μL gDNA Removal Mix and incubate 2 min at 45°C.
Add 5 μL RT mix (consisting of 4 μL RT mix and 1 μL RT enzyme).
Incubate with the following program for cDNA synthesis: 3 min at 25°C.
Incubate the mixture for 10 minutes at 45°C.
Incubate the mixture for 5 minutes at 85°C.
Prepare a PCR reaction mix of 25 μL according to the specified protocol.
Run the PCR as per the provided conditions.
Load the PCR products onto an agarose gel for electrophoresis.
Dissolve 1.5 g of agarose in 100 mL of 1×TBE buffer and heat until clear.
Add 9 μL of Midori Green to the solution.
Pour the prepared mixture into a gel casting chamber and allow it to harden at room temperature for 30-45 minutes.
Place the hardened gel onto the tray of the electrophoresis chamber, ensuring that the gel is fully covered with 1×TBE buffer.
Load 20 μL of samples along with a DNA page ruler onto the gel.
Connect the electrophoresis chamber to the power supply and run at 120 V for 90 minutes.
Remove the gel from the casting chamber.
Place the gel onto the Bio-Rad Molecular Imager ChemiDoc™ XRS or equivalent imager capable of taking UV images.
Excise two bands at approximately 700 bp and 250 bp under UV-lighting and transfer them into 2 mL tubes.
Extract PCR products using the QIAquick Gel Extraction Kit following manufacturer instructions.
Elute DNA from the QIAquick column with 25 μL nuclease-free water.
Send 20 μL from the extracted DNA for Sanger sequencing analysis with the LDB3-exon 4 forward primer to Microsynth (Göttingen).
Paste the nucleotide sequence of human LDB3 locus in the Clustal Omega webpage sequences window.
Paste the nucleotide sequence obtained from Sanger sequencing of the PCR bands underneath the first query.
Blast the longer sequence against the human LDB3 sequence and align at LDB3 exon 4, 5, 6 and 7.
Blast the shorter sequence against the human LDB3 sequence and align with LDB3 exon 4, 5, 6 and 7.
Design qPCR primers for expression of specific LDB3 exons.
Prepare 20 μL qPCR reaction mix containing the following: 1 μL (5 ng) cDNA, 10 μL SYBR Green mix (2×), 1 μL of each forward and reverse primer (stock 10 μM) and 8 μL of water.
Run qPCR.
